_note: Decision rules for checklist 2.14 (E2) and 2.15 (perea-root), written 2026-10-17 before any analysis was run (evaluation-standards item 10). All intervals 95 %, cluster bootstrap (page where the set has page ids, else line), 2000 reps; BH-FDR q = 0.1 via scripts/eval_stats.bh over each table's family of tests.

2.14.E2-a dot-pair token sequences: Per tokenizer (Qwen BPE shared by all Qwen-lineage VLMs; Gemma-2 SentencePiece for PaliGemma2), over panel GT words with a dot-group letter: a single dot swap (within-group letter change) vs a control swap at the same position to a letter of another group. CONCLUDE 'dot pairs get unrelated token sequences' if the mean token-multiset Dice of dot-swap pairs is not above the control's by more than 0.05 (upper CI of dot - control < 0.05). CONCLUDE 'tokenizer keeps dot pairs related' if dot - control > 0.05 with the CI excluding 0.05.
2.14.E2-b tokenizer prior in dot errors: Over word substitutions whose rasm (dotless skeleton) equals the GT's (pure dot errors), among pairs whose token counts differ: share where the reading has FEWER tokens than the GT. KEEP 'VLM dot errors drift toward lower-fertility spellings' if, for at least 2 VLMs, the share > 0.5 with p surviving BH q=0.1 across VLMs, AND the pooled VLM share minus the CRNN control share (same tokenizer applied to CRNN dot errors; the CRNN has no tokenizer) is > 0 with the CI excluding 0. Otherwise DROP.
2.14.E2-c fertility vs CER: Line level: partial Spearman of fertility (GT tokens per GT word) with line CER (no-diacritics rung), partialling out mean word length, per model x dataset (>= 50 lines). Word level: within (dataset, word length) strata, slope of word error on token count. KEEP 'fertility predicts errors beyond length' if the word-level slope > 0 surviving BH q=0.1 for >= 2 VLMs AND the pooled VLM slope exceeds the CRNN control slope (same tokenizer) with the CI of the difference excluding 0. If VLM and CRNN slopes are alike, fertility is a word-rarity proxy, not a tokenizer effect: DROP as a tokenizer claim.

2.15.perea-root: Real-word substitution: a 1:1 aligned word substitution where GT and reading are both Arabic-letter words of >= 2 letters, differ, and the reading is in the Common lexicon (Ayaspell, aspell-ar, Pecina, Arabic Wikipedia sample). Root share: the CAMeL Tools MSA (calima-msa-r13) root sets of the two words intersect (any analysis). Chance: (i) edit-distance-matched neighbours (lexicon words at the same Levenshtein distance from the GT word, distance 1 enumerated, distance 2 sampled, up to 30 per word), (ii) shuffled pairing of the model's GT and reading words. KEEP 'real-word substitutions share the root more than chance' if observed minus neighbour baseline > 0 with the CI excluding 0 and surviving BH q=0.1 across models, in at least two families (CRNN and a VLM family). If it holds only for VLMs, report as an LM-prior effect; if for none, DROP.
